about.title: Personal Injury Help in Brentwood, California
about.longDescription: Brentwood has grown quickly, and its roads carry that growth every day. Public records show 165 injury collisions in the most recent reporting year, hurting 232 people and taking 3 lives. Corridors like Balfour Road, Brentwood Boulevard, Sand Creek Road, and SR-4 see steady traffic and, with it, a steady share of these collisions. If you were hurt on one of these roads, or anywhere else in the city, the days after can feel overwhelming — medical visits, insurance calls, missed work, and mounting questions about what comes next. LawProactive exists to make one part of that easier. We are a free service, not a law firm, and we don't charge you anything to connect you with an independent personal injury attorney who can review what happened and explain your options. Any attorney in our network works on contingency, meaning there's no fee unless they recover money for you. Our goal is simply to help you find someone who can walk through the details with you and help you decide what to do next, without adding to what you're already carrying.

whyChoose.title: Why People in Brentwood Turn to LawProactive

items.title: You Have a Limited Window
items.desc: California generally gives you two years from the date of injury to file a claim, though claims against a government agency can require notice in as little as six months. Talking to someone sooner helps preserve your options.

items.title: Shared Fault Doesn't Erase Your Claim
items.desc: California follows pure comparative fault, so even if you were partly responsible for what happened, you can still pursue compensation for the share that wasn't your fault.

items.title: No Ceiling on Pain and Suffering Damages
items.desc: In ordinary injury cases, California places no cap on non-economic damages like pain and suffering, which can matter a great deal depending on your recovery.

items.title: You Pay Nothing Upfront
items.desc: Attorneys in our network work on contingency, so there's no fee unless they win or settle your case.

items.question: How much does it cost to get connected with an attorney through LawProactive?
items.answer: Nothing. LawProactive is a free service, and we don't charge you to connect you with an independent attorney. Any fees an attorney charges only come into play if they recover money for you, since attorneys in our network work on contingency.

items.question: How long do I have to file a personal injury claim in Brentwood?
items.answer: California generally allows two years from the date of the injury to file most personal injury claims. If a government entity is involved, such as the city or county, the notice period can be much shorter, sometimes just six months, so it's worth checking sooner rather than later.

items.question: What if I was partly at fault for the accident?
items.answer: California uses a pure comparative fault rule, which means you can still recover compensation even if you share some responsibility. Your total recovery would simply be reduced by your percentage of fault, not eliminated.

items.question: Where do crashes tend to cluster in Brentwood?
items.answer: Public collision records show that corridors such as Balfour Road, Brentwood Boulevard, Sand Creek Road, and SR-4 account for a notable share of reported injury collisions, with activity often peaking on Fridays between 3 and 5 p.m. These are simply reported counts, not a judgment about any particular road.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm?
items.answer: No. LawProactive is a free connection service. We're not a law firm and we don't provide legal representation ourselves; instead, we help connect injured people with independent attorneys who can evaluate their situation.
